subject.title: [Feature]: Per-bot context isolation in multi-bot Feishu groups - only record context when mentioned

question: Should Feishu add a new mention-only/per-bot context policy, reinterpret requireMention to stop recording skipped messages, or rely on existing historyLimit/contextVisibility controls?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior changes public config and documented group-history semantics, so automation should not choose the compatibility contract.

options.title: Add Explicit Context Policy
options.body: Add a Feishu-owned context policy such as mention-only/per-bot isolation while preserving current defaults for existing users.

options.title: Redefine requireMention
options.body: Treat requireMention as both a reply gate and a context gate, accepting a compatibility change for existing Feishu group users.

options.title: Use Existing Knobs Only
options.body: Document historyLimit/contextVisibility as the supported controls and decline a new Feishu-specific context policy.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Context Policy
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu-owned context policy such as mention-only/per-bot isolation while preserving current defaults for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is specific to the Feishu plugin's public behavior and the package metadata names this handle as the community maintenance owner.
